data.title: 爱夏·夜阑账房解衣
data.action: 在深夜账房反锁房门后倚坐桌沿，解开女仆连衣裙前襟与围裙系带，大敞衣襟露出饱满双乳与粉嫩乳头，单手撩起长裙裙摆展示大腿与吊袜带
data.lighting: 桌上暖色遮罩油灯与冷色窗棂月光
data.camera: medium cowboy shot, eye level, seated angle
data.description: 夜深人静，爱夏在核验完最后一叠账卷后反锁了书房。松懈下日间的严谨克制，她倚坐在坚实的胡桃木书桌边缘，解开深色女仆连衣裙的前襟，把白色围裙推到腰侧，任由薄棉衣料向两侧大敞，饱满雪白的双乳与娇嫩的粉红乳头完全袒露在微凉空气中。她一手轻抚锁骨下起伏的胸脯，另一手撩起深褐裙裾，展示出紧勒着吊袜带与黑色过膝袜的大腿线条，面泛潮红，目光微转。
data.promptProse: Inside the locked mansion accounting chamber late at night, adult Aisha Greyrat leans back against the polished walnut desk beside stacked parchment ledgers and an inkpot. A hooded desk lantern casts warm amber lamplight across her flushed collarbones and the wooden table surface, while soft pale moonlight cuts through the leaded windowpane behind her high auburn ponytail. One hand rests near her throat while the other lifts the hem of her dark maid skirt, revealing leather garter clips and dark thighhighs against smooth skin. Seated medium composition framed against book-lined walls.
